score_mapping_inferred_from_three_team_o.caveat: Linear transforms are inferred from three rounded team observations and are used for planning, not as an official scoring specification.

local_official_transport.selection_rule: Use Round B as backbone; require effect materially larger than local uncertainty.
Require intersection of exact same-season and locked p100 gates; ignore pooled surrogate.
Reject sub-millimetre local gains; require at least 0.030 m local gain with CI and slice gates.

registered_research_priority.structural_change: Recover only connected non-spike medium/long false-negative interiors on the frozen Round-B backbone.
registered_research_priority.primary_gate: Delta F1 >= +0.003; CI90 lower > 0; recall +0.008; precision loss <= 0.002; no new singleton or disconnected event.

registered_research_priority.structural_change: Learn dimensionless endpoint-normalized vertical curvature instead of absolute temperature residual.
registered_research_priority.primary_gate: Exact 2024 Sep-Oct Delta RMSE <= -0.015 C and CI90 upper <= -0.005; then locked p100 Delta <= -0.010 with 2/3 fold and layer wins.
